usecases.useCase: Salesforce Agreement to QuickBooks Invoice — event-driven invoice creation when a Salesforce agreement/opportunity reaches Closed Won
usecases.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft flow: Salesforce Platform Event (Agreement Created) → QuickBooks invoice creation with line items (products, quantities, pricing) mapped from Salesforce Opportunity products
usecases.outcome: Eliminated manual double-entry of invoice data; Crystal's billing workflow reduced from ~30 min/invoice to fully automated
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 3: Agentforce monitors unpaid invoices in Salesforce and drafts AR follow-up communications to district finance contacts

clients.projectContext: K-12 curriculum publisher (print SABs + digital access); sells to school districts by academic year with back-to-school seasonality; regional ISBNs vary by state

usecases.useCase: QuickBooks payment status sync to Salesforce Agreement — scheduled polling of QB invoice open balance, payment date, and invoice number written back to Salesforce Agreement custom fields
usecases.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft scheduled flow: QB invoice query by account/invoice ID → upsert to Salesforce Agreement object (QB Invoice #, date, amount, open balance fields)
usecases.outcome: Sales ops and finance see real-time payment status in Salesforce without logging into QuickBooks; eliminated manual AR update step
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 3: Agentforce proactively flags overdue agreements to the sales rep and drafts district finance contact email

clients.projectContext: K-12 curriculum publisher (print SABs + digital access); sells to school districts by academic year with back-to-school seasonality; regional ISBNs vary by state

usecases.useCase: Inventory spreadsheet to Salesforce custom object sync — scheduled ingestion of demand worksheet (titles, quantities, committed vs available, cost) into a Salesforce custom Inventory object for executive dashboards
usecases.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft scheduled flow: Google Sheets connector → transform to Salesforce custom Inventory__c object → upsert by title/ISBN; dashboard in Salesforce shows committed, available, projected shorts
usecases.outcome: Eliminated manual report exports; leadership can answer real-time inventory questions in Salesforce without contacting the fulfillment manager
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 2: automated shortage alerts when available inventory falls below 3% buffer threshold; Phase 3: Agentforce generates procurement recommendations based on pipeline stage probabilities

clients.projectContext: K-12 curriculum publisher (print SABs + digital access); sells to school districts by academic year with back-to-school seasonality; regional ISBNs vary by state

usecases.useCase: QuickBooks inventory and product cost sync to Salesforce — QB inventory item quantities and cost values written to Salesforce Inventory object for unified cost-per-program reporting
usecases.whatWasBuilt: MuleSoft scheduled flow: QB Item/Inventory query → DataWeave transform to Salesforce Inventory__c fields (unit cost, quantity on hand, ISBN) → upsert
usecases.outcome: Finance can answer multi-year spend questions per product line directly in Salesforce; eliminates cross-system lookup between QB and SF
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 3: Agentforce answers executive natural-language queries about historical spend and inventory by reading the synced Inventory__c + cost data in Salesforce

usecases.useCase: Agentforce for K-12 curriculum sales — AI account summaries and meeting prep for district-facing sales reps
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Agentforce agent that mines Salesforce Opportunity and Account data to generate real-time account summaries (deal amounts, past activity, key contacts, similar closed-won opportunities) on demand before district calls
usecases.outcome: 92% reduction in account research time (from up to 1 hour to 5–10 minutes per rep); 90% reduction in time spent on sales emails; increased win rates and faster deal cycles
usecases.aiLayer: Agentforce: autonomous AI agent delivers account intelligence in seconds when a rep opens a Salesforce record or receives an inbound call
usecases.prospectNote: Direct K-12 curriculum competitor to AgileMind — both sell to school districts. Already running Agentforce on the same Salesforce platform. DataSkate prospect for MuleSoft data layer work.

usecases.useCase: Agentforce for educational publisher student service — autonomous resolution of semester-start access and billing surges
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Agentforce + Service Cloud deployment to handle thousands of simultaneous student service requests at semester start — autonomous resolution of account access issues, password resets, registration and payment triage
usecases.outcome: 213% ROI on Service Cloud investment; 40%+ efficiency gain in case resolution in first weeks; 50% faster onboarding for new service agents
usecases.aiLayer: Agentforce: AI agent handles inbound student requests autonomously, escalating only payment and registration edge cases to humans with full context pre-loaded
usecases.prospectNote: Large educational publisher with Salesforce at its core. Likely has backend ERP/billing systems not yet connected to Salesforce. DataSkate prospect for MuleSoft integration modernization.

usecases.useCase: Salesforce enterprise-wide Agentforce deployment — full AI agent suite across Sales, Service, Marketing, and Data for a global educational publisher
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Full Agentforce suite (Sales, Service, Marketing, Data) deployed across business; customer service partially automated with AI agents working alongside human agents for escalations
usecases.outcome: 25+ years of Salesforce depth; full Agentforce suite live in 2025; customer service functions partially AI-resolved
usecases.aiLayer: Agentforce across all four clouds: Sales, Service, Marketing, Data
usecases.prospectNote: World's largest educational publisher. Global publishing operations, workforce credentials, assessment divisions — all candidates for MuleSoft integration. DataSkate enterprise prospect.

usecases.useCase: Salesforce Sales Cloud as the spine of a K-12 publishing digital transformation — standardizing sales, service, and analytics on one platform
usecases.whatWasBuilt: HMH standardized the entire sales org on Sales Cloud in 2012, added Service Cloud and Chatter, then Wave Analytics for pipeline visualization and sell-through opportunity analysis. Drove digital revenue from under 20% to over 50% of total revenue by 2015.
usecases.outcome: 50%+ of $1.37B revenue became digital by 2015; content reaches nearly 50 million students across 150 countries annually
usecases.aiLayer: Wave Analytics: real-time pipeline visualization enabling commercial action on insights that previously required manual reporting
usecases.prospectNote: Acquired by Veritas Capital in 2022 — post-acquisition tech stack may be in flux. DataSkate prospect for integration modernization. Scale: 50M students, $1.37B revenue.

usecases.outcome: 90%+ day-one Salesforce adoption; more accurate pipeline data within weeks; eliminated evening manual data entry

usecases.useCase: Salesforce Education Cloud for community college enrollment and student success automation — Dallas County Promise scholarship platform
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Built Dallas County Promise scholarship tracking platform on Salesforce Education Cloud in 7 weeks; Marketing Cloud automates personalized communications to 9,000 students guiding them through financial aid and college application steps
usecases.outcome: Platform launched in 7 weeks; automated student communication journeys for 9,000 enrollees; real-time visibility into promise program completion rates by high school partner
usecases.aiLayer: Marketing Cloud automation: AI-powered student journey personalization and automated communications across the full enrollment funnel
usecases.prospectNote: Local DFW institution — regional credibility signal in AgileMind proposals. Not a direct DataSkate integration prospect but a reference-able local proof point.

usecases.sourceNote: GSV 150 listings at savvas.com/newsroom. sourceUrl null — only sources are Savvas's own press pages.
